steps.en: Install, grant recording permissions and download local models
steps.zh: 安装、授予录音权限并下载本地模型

steps.en: Start a recording before the meeting
Save microphone and system audio as separate local tracks
steps.zh: 把麦克风与系统声音分别保存到本地

steps.en: Stop the recording when the meeting ends
Transcribe locally and label speaker turns
steps.zh: 在本机转写并标注说话人片段

steps.en: With AI enhancements enabled, generate speaker names, a summary and a title
steps.zh: 启用 AI 增强时生成说话人姓名、摘要与标题

value.en: Keep a searchable meeting record without sending the recording to an inference service
value.zh: 不把录音交给推理服务，也能留下可检索的会议记录
